summary: A failed comfy install leaves an engine that passes /engine/status and /engine/deps-status, has a real clone and a 359-package venv, and still cannot boot (No module named sqlalchemy) because ComfyUI core requirements never ran and no version stamp was written. Retry routes to deps-only because engineReady is judged by the venv python, which exists from step 1 on the uv path. No in-app recovery exists. Downstream of MPI-411.
User called this a 1.3.0 release blocker: quitting during the long first install and returning is an ordinary path, and Retry silently reports success on a dead engine.
maturity planned -> in-progress; checklist + validation linked.
Derived checklist from the root-cause brief (routing, repair-deps guard, docs, verification).
Retry now routes on /engine/version-check; repair-deps refuses an unstamped engine and hands back to the full install. Live interrupted-install retry still outstanding (Windows leg).
maturity in-progress -> validating (code shipped, live proof outstanding).
